body.statement: For a strict priority order \(\pi\), a set \(S\subseteq V\) equals the sequential greedy output on \(C_G\) if and only if \(S\) is independent in \(C_G\) and every \(v\in V\setminus S\) has a neighbor \(u\in S\) that precedes \(v\) in \(\pi\).
body.justification: The certificate converts a history-dependent greedy process into separator-local independence and domination constraints.
body.gap: Random sequential adsorption studies the same process probabilistically, but the separator-local certificate is not developed there for marked exact integration.
body.consumer: It is the logical invariant needed by both a tree-decomposition algorithm and a parameterized-hardness reduction.
